annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT), Oman
key_provisions_or_claims: Programme approved by Cabinet on 19 September 2024, aligned with Oman Vision 2040
Three pillars: adoption in economic sectors, localizing AI technologies, governing AI with a human-centered vision
Aims to raise digital economy contribution from 2% in 2021 to 10% by 2040
Plans to review and update laws and develop flexible regulations; protect privacy and govern data and algorithms
Flagship projects: Oman GPT, Oman AI Studio, National Open Data Portal
annotation.summary_en: Ministry web page describing Oman's National Program for Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Digital Technologies, approved by Cabinet in September 2024. It outlines three pillars (adoption, localization, human-centered governance), targeted sectors, flagship projects and an FAQ, with only brief references to ethical use, privacy and law updates.
